summary: Improve public-authority control of PPP risks, payments, performance and amendments. Explore the five-day course and practical contract tools.
lede: PPP contract governance connects contract clauses with service delivery, payments and public-sector oversight. For public procurement, legal, PPP-unit and infrastructure programme teams, the training develops practical ways to review risk allocation, monitor performance and control amendments across a contract lifecycle. Participants also map payment evidence and dispute pathways and prepare fiscal-risk updates using contract registers and monitoring records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public-sector professionals who shape or oversee PPP agreements and need to connect contract clauses with delivery, payment and fiscal-control decisions.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to public procurement, infrastructure delivery, contract administration or public financial management is recommended. You should be able to read basic contract clauses and discuss approval responsibilities in your work context. No coding or programming is required.
